meta.title: Castlefolk — Build. Rule. Conquer.
meta.description: Castlefolk is a charming pixel-art kingdom strategy game. Build settlements, gather resources, raise armies, battle monsters and expand your kingdom.
meta.ogAlt: A Castlefolk settlement surrounded by forest, with knights massed on the grass

hero.lede: Build your settlement, gather resources, raise an army, and carve your kingdom out of a dangerous medieval world.
hero.madeWith: A pixel-art strategy game made with Godot 4
hero.imageAlt: A Castlefolk village of stone and timber houses beside the sea, with squads of knights and spearmen on the grass

pitch.heading: A kingdom, from one small settlement

build.title: Build your kingdom
build.text: Start with a small settlement and turn it into a thriving kingdom.

gather.title: Gather & grow
gather.text: Harvest wood, hunt for meat and mine gold to keep your people fed and working.

army.title: Raise your army
army.text: Recruit warriors, archers, lancers and monks, then drill them into a fighting force.

conquer.title: Defend & conquer
conquer.text: Fight dangerous creatures and rival kingdoms for control of the map.

build.title: Build
build.text: Construct castles, houses, barracks, towers, monasteries and more. Every building you raise changes what your settlement can do next.
build.imageAlt: The build menu open over a settlement, with a rival castle visible in the distance

explore.title: Explore
explore.text: Discover forests, mountains, rivers, coastlines and dangerous wilderness. The map hides both resources and the things that guard them.
explore.imageAlt: The parchment strategy map showing friendly green territory beside a rival purple kingdom

manage.title: Manage
manage.text: Balance population, resources, construction and military strength. Every soldier you train is a villager who stops gathering.
manage.imageAlt: The barracks interface with garrison slots and a unit training progress bar

fight.title: Fight
fight.text: Command your forces in real-time battles against monsters and rival lords. Position matters as much as numbers.
fight.imageAlt: Knights fighting skeleton warriors and a minotaur across a wooden bridge

expand.title: Expand
expand.text: Establish new settlements and push your borders outward across the coastline and into the hills.
expand.imageAlt: A player drag-selecting squads of knights with a selection rectangle

conquer.title: Conquer
conquer.text: Turn a tiny settlement into a kingdom capable of ruling the entire world.
conquer.imageAlt: A large army of knights, spearmen and archers formed up on open grass

screenshots.heading: Screenshots
screenshots.lede: Every image below is from the game as it plays today.

world.heading: A world worth ruling
world.lede: Castlefolk is played at kingdom scale. Beyond your walls there are forests to clear, coastlines to settle, rival lords to outgrow — and things in the wilderness that will happily eat a lone woodcutter.

map.title: One map, many claims
map.text: Zoom out to the parchment map to see the whole world: your territory, your rival's, and everything still unclaimed between them.
map.imageAlt: The parchment strategy map with green and purple territories marked

monsters.title: The wilderness bites back
monsters.text: Goblins, trolls, gnolls and worse hold the ground you want. Some of them are a nuisance. Some of them end an expedition.
monsters.imageAlt: Skeleton warriors and a minotaur defending an island across a bridge

bestiary.title: Know your enemy
bestiary.text: Every creature has a bestiary entry with its stats and a little too much personality.
bestiary.imageAlt: A parchment bestiary card for the minotaur showing health, attack and speed

roadmap.heading: In development
roadmap.lede: Castlefolk is being built in the open. Here is what works today and what is still being made. No dates — it is ready when it is good.

cta.heading: Your kingdom awaits.
cta.text: Build your settlement. Raise your army. Defend your people. Conquer the world.
cta.note: Wishlisting tells us people want this, and reminds you the day it launches.
